original_test_intent: Validate PLDM GPU firmware update support through BMC Web in a defined alternate host power state, with uninterrupted update, exact target activation and successful later recovery/health verification.
original_method: After resolving the authoritative host state, validate signed image/target, establish stable BMC/OOB power, have an operator select and Start the UI update, monitor progress/audit without host power changes, then perform only approved activation/recovery and verify active inventory/device health.
manual_activity: Engineering resolves host state and change contract; operator confirms Start and supervises power/OOB; engineer owns verdict/recovery.
required_inputs: Decision on booted OS versus standby/off with BMC on
Signed PLDM image/manifest/checksum and exact component target
BMC UI/PLDM version, current/target inventory and compatibility
Backup/rollback/activation and later host power-on plan
Stable BMC power/network, OOB/operator and protected evidence
safety_requirements: Do not flash until power-state conflict is resolved
Prove stable BMC power and prohibit unauthorized host transition
Require explicit operator Start and uninterrupted progress monitoring
Recover/activate once by approved procedure and verify all health
agent_execution_scope: Collect pre-state and validate supplied artifact metadata
Assist only in the approved UI/method after state decision
Do not choose state/image/target, press Start autonomously, retry or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Decide authoritative host state or split variants

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level standby flow is incomplete and cannot execute until the source title/procedure state conflict is resolved; Redfish is not automatic equivalence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After authority selects the state, use the approved BMC GPU Firmware UI with verified artifact and explicit operator Start while maintaining the required power state and audit trail.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC Web image selection/Start and standby instruction are preserved alongside the conflicting title and source 5/5 estimate.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a state-locked signed change record joining host/BMC power proof, artifact/target, operator action, update task/progress, activation, active version and recovery health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the contradictory power state explicit and adds firmware safety/recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Booted-OS row169 remains independent unless an approved decision merges/splits it.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some platforms require a host/BMC action to activate firmware; that exception must be preapproved and must not be mistaken for accidental power-on.

project_override_considerations: Authority must resolve or split the booted-OS title versus standby procedure and document relationship to row169; no easier power state may be selected implicitly.
expected_evidence: Power-state decision and verified host-off/BMC-on or booted state
UI navigation/selected image/operator Start and audit
Approved activation/recovery and exact active target version
Host/GPU/driver/BMC health, rollback readiness and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title explicitly says boot into OS while Procedure step 1 says standby and do not power on. Firmware behavior and risk differ by host state; no reviewer may choose one without a decision.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review and conflict capture are complete; a project decision/artifact can be supplied while remaining cases continue.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row170 Wistron-AMD GPU-00163-V002: decide whether the PLDM BMC-Web update is performed with OS booted as the title states, host in standby/off with BMC on as Procedure states, or as separate variants; define relationship to row169 and approve signed image/target, stable power/network, operator Start, update/activation/rollback/OOB and post-recovery health evidence.

review_improvement: Exposes the material power-state contradiction and adds a signed, state-locked, operator-confirmed and recoverable firmware update contract.
independent_technical_reasoning: Host-on and standby updates exercise different PLDM routes, device availability and activation behavior. A successful update in one state cannot prove the other. Power-state telemetry must be part of the evidence because accidentally booting the host during a standby flash can violate vendor sequencing and increase brick risk.
